coordinate_units: native tablet units; no millimeter conversion
pressure_units: native tablet units; no per-record normalization
stroke_definition: maximal consecutive run of identical pen state; includes single-point runs
duration_definition: sum of valid consecutive timestamp intervals; a valid state transition contributes half to each state; transition duration is also reported separately, not added again to total
stroke_duration_and_length: sum over valid intervals within the state run; no state transitions or invalid intervals
derivative_definition: velocity vectors at interval midpoints; successive differences over midpoint time differences for acceleration and jerk; summarize Euclidean vector norms
pressure_rate_definition: absolute consecutive pressure difference divided by seconds, within valid contact derivative runs
invalid_interval_policy: dt<=0 or dt>60000ms contributes no time or length and splits derivative runs; no interpolation or invented nominal timestamps
long_valid_interval_policy: preserve intervals up to 60s; secant velocity measures average movement over the gap, not unobserved instantaneous motion
empty_distribution_policy: all six summaries zero; counts and empty names stored in diagnostics, never added as extra predictors
smoothing: none; finite differences can amplify temporal and coordinate quantization
supervised_feature_selection: none; all 83 features fixed before fitting
scope: independently specified kinematic+pressure SVM baseline inspired by Drotar 2016 signal families; not an exact reproduction

unit_evidence.time: old checkout README.md line 79 and src/pdhms/pahaw/svc_loader.py line 68 explicitly identify milliseconds; positive input dt median 8 and p99=15 native units are consistent with milliseconds
unit_evidence.coordinates: dataset/PaHaW/PaHaW_files/info.txt gives Y then X; PaHaW_matlab/read_SVC_file.m swaps them, and contains only a commented coordinate conversion; retain native units
unit_evidence.sampling: use observed timestamp differences, not either nominal frequency reported in earlier sources

prefit_audit_decision: before extraction/fitting and without labels: 147 positive intervals >1000ms, of which 145 are 1-26.61s and two approximately 1.334e12ms; proposed 1s cutoff replaced with 60s to retain plausible long pauses. Nonpositive intervals are also excluded. No performance-based choice.
